thread:
maya: quick heads-up — prepping a rebuild of base-image v2 to remove a glibc workaround and add seccomp. Need RBAC + KMS preflight for image-sentry SA to sign attestations. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infer-platform/pull/1284 :eyes:
hiro: what's current permission set on image-sentry? I only see storage.objects.get and run-as.
maya: it's currently serviceAccount:image-sentry@redwood-prod. Need kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign on projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/bakes/cryptoKeys/image-signer and iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob for the keystore controller.
eli: audit logs should be structured. We should emit: actor, sa_email, key_version, key_fingerprint, image_digest, repo, action, nonce. Sample log payload below so logging folks can validate parsing.
eli: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-21T14:12:03Z","actor":"image-sentry","sa":"image-sentry@redwood-prod","key":"projects/.../cryptoKeyVersions/3","fingerprint":"sha256:abcd...","image":"gcr.io/redwood/base@sha256:...","action":"sign","nonce":"6f2c"}
```
sam: can we avoid granting long-term sign privileges? prefer short-lived signer via Workload Identity + key attestation proxy.
maya: yes — the intent is short-lived KMS access via a signer sidecar that mTLSs to KMS and exchanges an ephemeral token. We still need iam.serviceAccounts.actAs for the sidecar SA to impersonate the controller for the short window. TTLs limited to minutes.
hiro: ops question — how will this affect the canary rollout? need a fallback if signer unavailable.
maya: canary flow: build -> sign in staging (signed by staging-key) -> push -> smoke tests -> promote. Fallback: if signing fails, mark build unsigned and block automatic release. Manual override path exists for emergency patches (ops-only).
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Keystore role binding applied to image-sentry-sa in staging at 2026-03-21T14:40Z by maya :white_check_mark:
security-oncall: scheduling oncall review in 30m. Please post a short runbook checklist: RBAC change, KMS key ACLs, Audit field mapping, Rollback steps, Canary window.
maya: checklist posted in PR + runbook gist: https://gist.github.com/maya/234a. Quick items: 1) Add binding roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier to keystore-controller-sa (staging only), 2) Add audit sink for 'image-sign' structured logs, 3) Run canary for 30m, 4) Verify audit entries contain key_version and image digest, 5) If audit missing fields -> rollback RBAC.
eli: terraform snippet for binding to mirror in infra-as-code:
eli: ```hcl
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "signer" {
  crypto_key_id = "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/bakes/cryptoKeys/image-signer"
  role = "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier"
  members = ["serviceAccount:image-sentry@redwood-prod"]
}
```
sam: noted. I'll open a tiny RBAC PR to mirror to prod after staging verification.
maya: thanks — I'll run the canary at 14:50 and ping when logs look good. :thumbsup:
